_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Ngwe udi Mwana-kudikila {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Kimbundu kya kuwina, ngwe udi na kudikila mitatu mfululizo (ku lunga, ku tala, kana ku mpaka) ku tala ya kudikila.
Kwa kudikila kwaku, ngwe udi na kuteka ombala ya kudikila (0-8) ngwe unganaka kuteka kima kwaku.
Kwa kudikilakwaku, '[4]' kuteka kima kwaku ku kati ya tala ya kudikila.
Ngwe Mwana-kudikila {player_id}, ngwe udi na kuwa '{symbol}', kana ngwe udi na kudikila '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: O ima i ua mu soneka, ki iala kala kia tokala.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O kijimbuete kia {cell}, ki tena kulombolola o muxinda ua kidi. Kia tokala kukala bhu kaxi ka 0 ni 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: O kijimbuete {cell}, mu kaxa kene kiá ni muthu.

game_action.placed: Mwana {player_id} alitumia ishara yake ({symbol}) kwenye seli {cell}.
